# Vendored JavaScript libraries

Local copies, so that the dashboard charts work without an internet connection.
Taken from the npm registry; all three are BSD-3-Clause licensed (University of Washington Interactive Data Lab).

| file | package |
|---|---|
| `vega.min.js` | vega 5.30.0 |
| `vega-lite.min.js` | vega-lite 5.21.0 |
| `vega-embed.min.js` | vega-embed 6.26.0 |
